notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR34: data-name-6 'indicates the status condition of the previously executed' DISABLE, ENABLE, PURGE, RECEIVE or SEND statement, by Table 1 of §1985:XIV.2.2.5. Every communication statement runs through MessageControlSession.Statement, which stores the action's status with CommunicationArea.SetStatus; SetPath, Send, Purge and Receive return Table 1's values, and since kb/Work PB5393 SetPath answers 80 when a known queue prefix is already in the requested state and a lower level is unknown. Probes at --std 85 (class b, each Table 1 row; a, c, d, e and f do not reach a status-key rule), I-O CD: SEND to an unknown terminal 20, ENABLE I-O TERMINAL with a wrong KEY 40, already enabled 15, SEND text length 6 of a 5-character item 50, a zero-length portion or a zero indicator with no FROM 60, zero length WITH EMI 00, PURGE with no portion 70 and with one 00, DISABLE 00 then 15, SEND to the disabled terminal 10, RECEIVE from an unknown terminal 21; the sibling formats agree (ENABLE INPUT Q1/unknown 80, DISABLE Q1 off/unknown 80, SEND unknown plus disabled 80 with error keys 1 and 2, destination count 0 or 3 of 2 is 30). The witness covers 00, 15 and 10. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5393 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5393 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "The content of the data item referenced by data-name-6 indicates the status condition of the previously executed ... RECEIVE, or SEND"; 2023: "No communication description entry; the Communication module is absent from the 2023 candidates". The 2023 standard lacks the communication description entry and its status key. No candidate covers CD entries or RECEIVE/SEND status, so the feature was dropped.
